build_adaptive_span_model: build an adaptive span transformer language model from config and task using build_model
get_auxiliary_loss: get the auxiliary loss value from the adaptive span transformer model during training
get_current_max_span: get the current maximum attention span value from the adaptive span decoder model
get_current_avg_span: get the current average attention span value from the adaptive span decoder model
init_hidden_cache: initialize the hidden state cache tensors for each layer in the adaptive span decoder
